sentences.text: FDA's records show gemcitabine hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 87 vials of the 2 g/52.6 mL presentation with 31 days on hand at current use.
Corvale Lakeside holds 13 vials of the same presentation with 13.5 days on hand at current use.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Avyxa Pharma, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Avyxa Pharma, LLC's label names no plant we could place.
Alternative manufacturers Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC are also not on FDA's shortage list today and their labels name no plant we could place.
